CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `userCaseViews` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `caseId` int NOT NULL,
  `firstViewedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `userCaseViews_userId_caseId_uniq` (`userId`, `caseId`)
);
